race.comment: OF THE VIEW (1) has trialled nicely since moving stables. She always shows speed in her races. Will be needing some fortune off the draw but if she does show pace, it might be offset quickly. At least at this journey, it is more likely. BUCKO'S WISH (7) has been close up at her last three outings. This distance might be about her sweet spot. Will be running on hard. SOUTHERN SKY (2) finds a winnable race even though it has been quite a while since her only victory. See how she goes for the new stable.  ALBERT'S PICK (6) brings in good consistent form lines. Will be getting a sweet run all the way.
